# DeepAgent — Reference

*Endpoints, environment variables, event types and identifiers. Generated by
reading `backend/main.py`, `backend/auth.py`, `temporal/`, `agent/` and
`frontend/src` on 2026-10-03. When code and this page disagree, fix this page.*

---

## 1. HTTP API

Base URL in development: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. All responses are JSON
except the SSE stream and artifact downloads.

**Auth column**: how the route behaves with `AUTH_ENABLED=true`. With the flag
off every route accepts anonymous requests and no scoping applies.

- *bearer* — requires `Authorization: Bearer <session_jwt>`, verified locally. 401 on any failure.
- *owner* — only rows owned by the caller's `(member, org)` are visible; anything else is 404.
- *admin+net* — additionally requires the `stytch_admin` role (403) and a network re-verification of `X-Session-Token` with an RBAC check (`org_skills` / `manage`).

### Health

| Method | Path | Auth | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health` | none | `{"status": "ok"}` |

### Runs

| Method | Path | Auth | Body / notes | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/runs` | bearer | `{"message": str, "thread_id"?: str}`. Over the org's daily quota → 429 with `limit`, `used`, `reset_at` and a `Retry-After` header. Duplicate workflow id → 409. | `{"run_id", "workflow_id", "thread_id"}` |
| POST | `/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | bearer, owner | Cancels the Temporal workflow. | `{"status": "cancel_requested", "run_id"}` |
| GET | `/runs` | bearer, owner | Newest first by artifact dir mtime. | `[{run_id, workflow_id, artifacts[], user_message, status, mtime}]` |
| GET | `/runs/{run_id}/stream` | bearer, owner | `text/event-stream`. Honours `Last-Event-ID` (resumes at offset+1). Live while the workflow runs, replay from JSONL once finished. `: ping` keepalive every 15 s. | SSE records `id: <offset>` / `data: <v1 envelope>` |

### Threads (conversations)

| Method | Path | Auth | Body / notes | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/threads` | bearer, owner | Non-deleted, newest `updated_at` first. | `[{thread_id, title, created_at, updated_at, run_count}]` |
| GET | `/threads/{thread_id}` | bearer, owner | Runs in creation order. | `{thread_id, title, created_at, updated_at, runs: [{run_id, status, created_at}]}` |
| PATCH | `/threads/{thread_id}` | bearer, owner | `{"title": str}`, clamped to 80 chars; empty → 422. | `{thread_id, title}` |
| DELETE | `/threads/{thread_id}` | bearer, owner | Soft delete. Runs, events and artifacts are kept. | `{thread_id, deleted: true}` |

### Skills

| Method | Path | Auth | Body / notes | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/skills` | bearer | Built-ins + this org's org rows + this member's user rows, sorted by tier then name. | `[SkillSummary]` |
| GET | `/skills/{skill_id}` | bearer, visible | Full record. | `SkillSummary + {body, files}` |
| POST | `/skills` | bearer | `{"body": "<SKILL.md>", "tier": "user"\|"org", "files"?: {path: content}}`. Spec violation → 422. Duplicate `(tier, name)` → 409. Lands `untrusted` + disabled. | `SkillSummary` |
| PATCH | `/skills/{skill_id}` | bearer, visible; org tier admin+net; built-in tier admin | `{"enabled"?: bool, "trust_state"?: "trusted"\|"untrusted"}`. Enabling an untrusted skill → 409. `trust_state` on a built-in → 409. Setting `untrusted` also disables. | `SkillSummary` |
| DELETE | `/skills/{skill_id}` | bearer, visible; org tier admin+net | Soft delete. Built-in → 409. | `{skill_id, deleted: true}` |

`SkillSummary` = `{skill_id, name, tier, description, source, trust_state, enabled, file_names[]}`.
Built-in ids are deterministic (`builtin-<name>`); org/user ids are opaque `uuid4().hex`.

### Artifacts

| Method | Path | Auth | Notes | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/artifacts/{run_id}/{filename}/sign` | bearer, owner | Checks ownership, path containment and existence, then mints a link valid for `ARTIFACT_SIGN_TTL_SECS`. | `{"url": "/artifacts/...?exp=&sig=", "expires_at": epoch}` |
| GET | `/artifacts/{run_id}/{filename}` | none, but with auth on a valid `exp`+`sig` query is required | `.html`/`.htm` served inline (for the sandboxed iframe) unless `?download=1`, which forces attachment. Everything else is always an attachment. Traversal, missing file, bad or expired signature → 404. | file |

### Request headers (auth on)

| Header | Value | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <session_jwt>` | every route except `/health` and artifact serve |
| `X-Session-Token` | opaque Stytch session token | org-skill writes only |
| `Last-Event-ID` | last offset received | `/runs/{id}/stream` |

## 2. Environment variables

Backend and worker read `.env` from the repo root via `python-dotenv`. The
frontend reads `frontend/.env` (Vite, `VITE_` prefix only).

### Required

| Variable | Used by | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | worker (via langchain-google-genai) | Gemini model access |
| `TAVILY_API_KEY` | worker | `web_search` tool. Unset → the tool returns an error string instead of searching |

### Core

| Variable | Default | Used by | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TEMPORAL_ADDRESS` | `localhost:7233` | backend, worker | Temporal server |
| `ARTIFACT_BASE` | `./artifacts` | backend, worker | Root for artifacts, registries, event logs and the checkpoint DB |
| `HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | backend (`python -m backend.main` only) | Bind address. `start.bat` passes `--host` to uvicorn directly |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | `http://localhost:3000,http://127.0.0.1:3000` | backend | Comma-separated allowed origins |
| `WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENT_ACTIVITIES` | `10` | worker | Cap on concurrent agent runs per worker process |
| `AGENT_RECURSION_LIMIT` | `30` | backend → `WorkflowInput` | Agent step budget per run. 15 is too low |
| `ARTIFACT_DIR` | unset | tools, fallback only | Used only when a tool runs outside an activity (no `RunContext`) |

### Auth (Stytch B2B)

| Variable | Default | Used by | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_ENABLED` | `false` | backend | The switch. `false` = single implicit user, pre-auth behaviour exactly |
| `STYTCH_PROJECT_ID` | — | backend | Required when the flag is on; missing → process exits at boot |
| `STYTCH_SECRET` | — | backend | Server-side only |
| `STYTCH_ENV` | `test` | backend | `test` or `live`; must match the keys |
| `ARTIFACT_SIGNING_SECRET` | random per process | backend | HMAC key for signed artifact links. Unset → links die on restart |
| `ARTIFACT_SIGN_TTL_SECS` | `60` | backend | Signed link lifetime |
| `RUN_QUOTA_PER_ORG_PER_DAY` | `100` | backend | Runs per org per local calendar day; over → 429 |

### Frontend (`frontend/.env`)

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `VITE_STYTCH_PUBLIC_TOKEN` | unset | Stytch public token. Unset → UI boots without a login screen (backend must have the flag off) |
| `VITE_API_BASE` | `http://<current host>:8000` | API origin. Set to `""` for same-origin behind a reverse proxy |

## 3. Event types

Every SSE `data:` payload is a v1 envelope:

```
v: 1 · run_id · offset (int, durable stream position) · ts (ISO-8601 UTC)
user_id, org_id (null with auth off) · type · type-specific fields
```

| `type` | Fields | Emitted when |
|---|---|---|
| `run.started` | `prompt` | activity begins |
| `text.delta` | `text` | model text, coalesced every 50 ms |
| `plan.snapshot` | `todos: [{content, status: pending\|in_progress\|completed}]` | each `write_todos` call; the UI replaces one plan panel in place |
| `skill.activated` | `name, tier, path, description` | `read_file` on a seeded `SKILL.md` (label "Skill activated"), or at the start of a continuing turn for skills already in context ("Skill in context") |
| `tool.started` | `step_id, name, args` (redacted, truncated) | any tool other than `write_todos` |
| `tool.progress` | `step_id, tool, message` | live lines from inside a tool (search query, URL read) |
| `tool.finished` | `step_id, name, status: "done", output_preview (≤500 chars), duration_ms` | tool returned |
| `file.created` | `filename, url` | a tool wrote a file, and again per file in the end-of-run scan (deduped by the UI) |
| `run.error` | `message` (`ExceptionType: text`, ≤300 chars) | agent raised; Temporal may retry |
| `run.finished` | `state: done\|cancelled\|error, summary?, artifacts?[], note?` | terminal. `note: "backfilled after backend restart"` marks a recovered run |

Terminal events are `run.finished` and `run.error`. The persister and the live
stream both stop at the first one.

Internal worker names, for reading `.events/*.jsonl` or `temporal/activities.py`:
`run_start → run.started`, `llm_token → text.delta`, `plan → plan.snapshot`,
`skill → skill.activated`, `tool_start/tool_progress/tool_end → tool.*`,
`file` and `artifact → file.created`, `error → run.error`,
`cancelled → run.finished{cancelled}`, `done → run.finished{done}`.

---

## 4. Identifiers

| Id | Shape | Minted by |
|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | `<slug of first 6 words, ≤40 chars>_<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>_<6 hex>` | API. The hex suffix is what makes it unique; the rest is for humans. Pre-fix ids without the suffix still parse |
| `workflow_id` | `agent-<run_id>` | API |
| `thread_id` | `uuid4().hex`, or `legacy-<run_id>` for runs that predate threads | API |
| `skill_id` | `builtin-<name>` for repo skills, `uuid4().hex` otherwise | API |
| `step_id` | LangChain run id of the tool invocation | worker |
| `user_id` / `org_id` | Stytch `member_id` / `organization_id`; `legacy`/`legacy` for pre-auth rows once the flag is on | Stytch via the API |

## 5. Ports

| Service | Port |
|---|---|
| React (Vite) | 3000 |
| FastAPI | 8000 |
| Temporal server | 7233 |
| Temporal UI | 8233 |

## 6. Command-line tools

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `python -m backend.main` | API with uvicorn reload, bound to `HOST` |
| `python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000` | API without reload (what `start.bat` runs) |
| `python -m temporal.worker` | worker |
| `python -m backend.claim_legacy --org <id> --member <id> [--unarchive] [--dry-run] [--from-user legacy] [--from-org legacy]` | move the pre-auth data bucket to a real member. Run with the backend stopped |
| `temporal server start-dev --db-filename .temporal.db` | Temporal dev server with persistence |
| `pytest` | collects `tests/test_*.py` (see `tests/README.md`) |
| `ruff check . && ruff format .` | lint and format `agent/ backend/ temporal/ tests/` |
